choices.text: Ride the wind out from under them before they find the head of the ridge

effects.log: They walk the ridge for a week looking for a dragon that has gone to the next province on a breeze. They go home with sore feet and a sketch of a rock.

choices.text: Let them reach the bare rock, then open your eye under their feet

ok.log: Twelve cultivators discover they have spent a night climbing what they came to kill. Most of them run. The alchemist drops the mortar, and you keep it, out of spite.

fail.log: The chain nets are blessed iron and they bite. You tear free, but a scale stays in the net, and the alchemist holds it up to the lantern like a jewel. (-20 health)

choices.text: Fog the ridge, and let them walk off the cliff path in it if they are fools

effects.log: They are not all fools. Most of them stand still till dawn. One is not so careful. The rest carry that one home, and do not come back this year.

events.text: A pedlar of medicines in the village market below your ridge is selling "genuine Azure Dragon shavings" from a tray: grey flakes of something that might be fish scale. People are buying. Two sect scouts in plain clothes are watching who sells, and asking where the pedlar got them.

choices.text: Let a real scale fall in the marketplace, and let the pedlar see the difference

effects.log: The pedlar weeps over the real thing and throws the tray in the river. The scouts write it all down. A real scale in a market is a map with your name on it.

choices.text: Go into the scouts' dreams: there is nothing here but a fishmonger's cheat

ok.log: Two scouts report a fish-scale swindle and a disappointing ridge. Their sect crosses your province off a list.

fail.log: One scout dreams of a fish. The other dreams of a dragon. They argue about it in a teahouse, loudly, in front of everyone.

events.text: A single hunter this time: a young cultivator from a poor sect with a borrowed spear, a sick master at home and a letter from a physician saying only the Azure Dragon Pill will help. {npc} stands at the bottom of your ridge and shouts up it. "I know I cannot win. I have to try. Come down!"

choices.text: Come down, and ask about the master

mem.note: came down and asked about my master

effects.log: {npc} hears what a dragon thinks of physicians who prescribe dragons, and goes home with a bag of herbs from the north slope that you breathed on all spring. The master lives three more years. It is not a pill. It is better than nothing.

choices.text: Let {him} climb, and climb, and never find the top

effects.log: Three days on a ridge that is always a little longer than it was. {npc} comes down exhausted and furious and alive.

choices.text: Break the borrowed spear, and nothing else

effects.log: The spear goes in two pieces across the path. {npc} kneels in front of them and cries, not from fear. You did not expect that.

events.text: The alchemist from the night of the lanterns has come back, older, with a sect behind {him} now and a long-handled spoon of jade. {npc} sets up a furnace at the foot of your ridge, in full sight, and lights it. "I can wait," {npc} calls up the slope. "You are long-lived. So is my sect. One day you will sleep too deeply in the autumn."

choices.text: Roll a cracked boulder down to the furnace door, with the dragon's regards

effects.log: The boulder rolls down the slope and stops at the furnace door. {npc} studies the crack and smiles. "Thank you," {npc} says. "It will remind me." It is the worst thank-you you have ever heard.

choices.text: Rain the furnace out, every night, for a year

effects.log: A year of soaked charcoal and a sect that learns nothing except patience. {npc} leaves in the spring with the furnace on a cart. It will be back.

choices.text: Dive early this autumn, and deep, where no spoon reaches

effects.log: You sleep the autumn under the roots of the ridge, deeper than you have ever gone. When you wake, the furnace is cold and the alchemist has moved to easier prey. For now.
